description.text: A triple-decker toadstool sandwich with arsenic sauce. Who would eat such a thing? Yes they would, actually.
Silly Diggle, Sugar Smiths are for Dwarves! Now with more marshmallows and sugar-frosted crunchy bits. Try not to choke on the toy surprise.
Letting the gin out of the bottle? What's next, cat out of the bag? Friends don't let friends drink and summon.
Turns out naked skeletons aren't nearly as sexy as you'd hoped.
This ring bears a tiny dial covered with magical symbols. Wearing it makes you feel smarter.
